evidenceCheck.summary: Run the existing documentation contracts, including strict recorded document/source freshness. Passing does not establish semantic review of unrecorded claims or dependencies.

guideRule.message: Review affected documentation against real callers and preserve honest current, historical and evidence boundaries.

explain.summary: The documentation-audit skill and maintenance guide already own this workflow. Artifact presence is only structural guidance; the existing documentation truth gate checks paths, examples, publication and recorded byte freshness. Human or independent source review owns semantic correctness.
mustDo: Run the docs:impact report from gate:for, or its --catch-up mode for accumulated changes. Review affected owners and account for unmapped paths; retain the coverage baseline until outstanding coverage is resolved.
Trace changed behavior through public callers and the owning implementation, then revisit the affected guide, README, diagram, example and generated reference.
Record the reviewed claims, document purpose, source hashes, actual checks and limits. A justified no-prose-change outcome is valid; a source hash refresh without re-review is not.
Classify dated designs and fixtures honestly. Regenerate from the owner rather than editing generated output.
mustNotDo: Do not claim that passing links, byte freshness or inventory coverage proves every product statement or platform.
Do not invent a second documentation validator, blanket approval workflow, or mandatory prose diff for behavior-neutral changes.
explain.exampleGood: A source change triggers re-review of its recorded guide claims; stale evidence fails the existing strict freshness check until that review is recorded.
explain.exampleBad: Replace source digests to clear the gate without reading callers, or add a token documentation line to satisfy a diff rule.
